org.yuemi.mmoaccessories.api.SlotDefinition
public record SlotDefinition(AccessorySlotId type, String displayName, int maxSlots, List<String> acceptedTypes, AccessorySlotGui gui) extends Record
Represents the definition of an accessory slot with its configuration.
